description: The driver cancels r.side at 50. t.q in it sleeps and ends at the cancel, but t.w waits on a Notify, which is not cancel-aware (sync/notify.rs: the future ignores the Cx), so it stays parked and the region cannot finish draining: close implies quiescence (INV-QUIESCENCE), so it never reaches Closed and the run ends with r.side not Closed and snapshot.quiescent false. t.m in r.main is unaffected and completes.
